name: adv_domain_steam_vs_moistair_rejected
source:
// Thermofluid (steam/water) meeting moist air on the shared bond must fail.
Source       SRC(f1, fluid$ = Water, mdot = 1.0, P = 101325, T = 350)
HeatingCoil  HTR(a1, a2, Q = 1000)
MoistAirSink SK(a2)
connect(SRC.out, HTR.in)
h = HTR.in.h

error.message: connect(src.out, htr.in): cannot connect a 'fluid' line (src.out) to a 'moistair' line (htr.in). Thermofluid ('fluid'), liquid ('liquid'), two-phase ('twophase'), pneumatic ('gas'), hydraulic ('oil') and humid-air ('moistair') are incompatible fluid connector types; couple them only through a heat exchanger.
